notes: Map selection reads the whole map list at once, so it no longer scrolls past the map it's looking for.
Oddport Academy is selected reliably, even when the map list doesn't open at the top.
Fixed the display scaling error showing for people at 100% scale who have Windows text size turned up.
Works with Roblox's new UI font. Map selection reads the new map names reliably again, including Oddport Academy.
Reads coins and XP correctly with the new reward screen, where an event item now sits between them.
Lost rounds are recognised. They still return to the lobby, and Discord marks them as lost.
If a hero fails to place, the retry now tries every hero instead of guessing which one is missing.
If the deep link opens Roblox but never joins, that now counts as a failure, so it switches to the browser launch after two.
New Slow mode in Settings for low-end PCs. It doubles the waits between steps and gives Roblox longer to load.
Cleaner Discord messages, and restart alerts that were silently missing now post.
Update notes like these now show after each update, and live in Guide → Updates.
Discord session reports every 15, 30 or 60 minutes, with a chart of the run.
Updates install from an in-app screen instead of the setup wizard.
Coin rewards read correctly at every supported resolution.
Clear message when AutoHotkey v2 is installed instead of v1.1.
Smaller install.
Upgrade time cap per hero, so a missed MAX check can't stall a run.
Restarts a map that hasn't finished after 14 minutes.
Live mana only reads during a match.
Dropped 4K support. 1440p and 1080p are supported.
Velora has a website, linked from the app.
Fixed the dead AutoHotkey download link.
Third hero, Oddport, on every map except Castle Town.
Oddport Academy is picked from the special maps menu.
Every restart closes Roblox first, so it never relaunches onto a frozen window.
Launches Roblox with a deep link, without opening a browser tab.
Launch method setting: deep link with browser fallback, or browser only.
No longer closes your browser window when a Roblox tab is open.
Automatic updates.
Fixes for 1080p: hero slot order, MAX detection and coin reading.
First public release.
